Indépendant | Rémunération à la commission uniquement | Territoire de vente local | Commissions déplafonnées

À propos de l'opportunité

Nous recherchons des commerciaux terrain expérimentés, à l'aise pour se rendre dans une entreprise, engager la conversation avec le propriétaire et convaincre de nouveaux commerçants.

En tant que conseiller commercial itinérant indépendant, vous vendrez les solutions de paiement, de point de vente et logicielles de SumUp aux petites et moyennes entreprises de votre région. Vous identifierez vous-même vos prospects, gérerez votre portefeuille d'opportunités et accompagnerez les clients lors de leur mise en route.

Vous devrez justifier d'une expérience en prospection à froid et apprécier la vente en face à face sur le terrain. Vous gérerez votre propre activité et organiserez vos démarches commerciales de manière autonome, tout en bénéficiant de la formation et du soutien de SumUp.

Vos missions

  • Trouver de nouveaux clients grâce à des visites en face à face, de la prospection en porte-à-porte et des démarches directes.
  • Cibler les entreprises locales générant d'importants volumes de paiement et susceptibles de tirer parti des produits SumUp.
  • Poser des questions sur le fonctionnement de chaque entreprise et recommander des solutions adaptées en matière de paiement, de matériel, de caisse et de logiciels.
  • Gérer le processus de vente depuis le premier échange, en passant par les démonstrations de produits, la gestion des objections et la conclusion, dans le cadre du partenariat.
  • Aider les clients à mettre en place et à commencer à utiliser leurs produits SumUp.
  • Établir des relations avec les chefs d'entreprise et demander des recommandations aux clients satisfaits.
  • Planifier vos visites et vos suivis afin d'optimiser votre temps sur le terrain.
  • Suivre votre activité, vos opportunités et vos résultats de vente, et transmettre les informations nécessaires au traitement des ventes.
  • Échanger avec votre interlocuteur SumUp pour bénéficier de son expertise produit et de conseils commerciaux.

Ce que nous recherchons

Indispensable

  • Au moins un an d'expérience dans la vente sur le terrain dans des secteurs tels que les télécommunications, l'énergie, les technologies d'entreprise, la gestion des déchets, les systèmes de sécurité ou l'approvisionnement en produits alimentaires et boissons.
  • Une expérience de la prospection à froid, notamment en démarchant des entreprises en face à face et en trouvant vos propres prospects.
  • Une expérience de la vente auprès de petites et moyennes entreprises et des relations directes avec les propriétaires ou les décideurs.
  • Des résultats démontrables en matière d'acquisition de nouveaux clients et d'atteinte d'objectifs commerciaux. Nous vous demanderons des exemples de vos réalisations et de la manière dont vous y êtes parvenu.
  • La capacité à gérer un processus de vente de la première prise de contact à la conclusion, y compris la gestion des questions et des objections.
  • Un bon sens de l'organisation et un suivi rigoureux.
  • La capacité à gérer les refus, à tirer les leçons des retours d'expérience et à persévérer.
  • Une bonne compréhension du statut d'indépendant et la volonté de développer votre portefeuille de clients.
  • La capacité à vous déplacer sur votre territoire de vente afin de rencontrer régulièrement vos prospects et clients.

Atouts

  • Un réseau existant de chefs d'entreprise locaux susceptibles de bénéficier des produits SumUp.
  • Une expérience dans le domaine des paiements, des services aux commerçants ou des systèmes de point de vente.

Une expérience de la vente par téléphone est un atout, mais vous devez également avoir vendu en face à face sur le terrain.

Rémunération

Il s'agit d'une activité indépendante, rémunérée exclusivement à la commission, sans salaire de base ni revenu minimum garanti. Les commissions sont déplafonnées et dépendent de vos résultats commerciaux et de l'activité des commerçants apportés.

Le système de commissions comprend, dans le cadre des conditions Partner :

  • Paiements : 50 % du revenu net annualisé lié aux transactions.
  • Matériel : 50 % du prix de vente retenu dans le barème.
  • Logiciels et abonnements : 50 % du montant annuel retenu dans le barème.
  • Revenu résiduel : 20 % du revenu net mensuel généré par les commerçants apportés, pendant une durée maximale de trois ans.
  • Avantage de bienvenue : trois fois le montant habituel des commissions résiduelles pendant les trois premiers mois.
  • Primes supplémentaires liées à certains produits ou opérations commerciales.

Les nouveaux partenaires bénéficient des conditions Partner pendant la période de lancement. Leur maintien est ensuite soumis aux critères d'activité du programme ; un barème Agent de 40 %, sans commissions résiduelles, peut s'appliquer.

Les conditions d'éligibilité, les bases de calcul et les modalités de versement sont précisées dans le contrat et présentées avant tout engagement. Les commissions s'entendent avant déduction de vos frais professionnels, cotisations sociales et impôts applicables.

Formation et accompagnement

Nous vous aiderons à vous familiariser avec les produits et leur commercialisation grâce à un parcours initial et à un accompagnement continu couvrant la prospection, les entretiens de vente, les démonstrations, la gestion des objections et l'accompagnement des clients.

Les modalités du parcours initial et les prérequis à la commercialisation vous seront communiqués avant le démarrage.

Votre interlocuteur SumUp vous apportera également son soutien en matière de développement territorial, d'analyse de vos opportunités et de conseils commerciaux, dans le respect de votre autonomie d'organisation.

Health can’t wait.

Alan exists to end the wait.

We’re opening an Enterprise Sales Team Lead role in France to lead a growing team of 4 Senior Account Executives, who are in charge of acquiring customers with more than 3,000 employees, including all CAC40 companies.

  • Perimeter: companies of 3000+ employees

The Role

Intellect delivers a clinically governed mental health programme to enterprise clients in the mining and resources sector, supporting remote and expatriate workforces. This is not a standard EAP. Cases begin with acute risk assessment on remote sites and run through structured treatment, fitness-for-work assessment and return-to-work clearance, in direct coordination with the client's chaplaincy, medical and people teams.

This role covers the client's United Kingdom operations and a West African project site where the working language is French. It is a combined clinical delivery and case management role: the postholder conducts the assessments, delivers the therapy, writes the reports and owns the case, rather than coordinating a provider network. That design reflects the absence of an established provider network in the West African market at launch, and gives the client a single clinician who knows each case end to end.

Full professional fluency in French and English is a non-negotiable requirement. Welfare calls, clinical assessment, case documentation and client communication in the West African market are conducted in French.

Responsibilities

Clinical assessment and delivery

  • Conduct acute risk and welfare assessments for employees referred through the client's escalation pathway, in French or English as required.
  • Deliver individual counselling and psychotherapy across the supported caseload, virtually.
  • Conduct fitness-for-work assessments and produce the associated clinical documentation.
  • Write risk assessments, session documentation, return-to-work memoranda and fitness-for-work reports to a standard that stands up to client and regulatory scrutiny, in the language the case requires.
  • Delivery is capped so that case management availability is protected. Session load is agreed with the Head of Clinical Operations and reviewed as volume changes.

Case management and coordination

  • Own each case end to end, from referral through assessment, treatment, fitness-for-work and reintegration to closure.
  • Align the initial support plan with the client's on-site teams, including session volume and cadence, and manage adjustments where clinically indicated.
  • Coordinate with internal helpline, care excellence and network partnership teams on anything that cannot be delivered directly.
  • Review the open case list for stalled items and follow up to keep cases moving.

Clinical risk oversight and governance

  • Confirm risk tiering against the client's framework and set review cadence and monitoring requirements.
  • Make the clinical decisions the pathway requires, including disputed risk ratings and medical evaluation pathways where an employee declines therapy.
  • Escalate to the Head of Clinical Operations where a case exceeds the scope of remote delivery or requires in-person intervention.
  • Work within the differing regulatory, medical and emergency-escalation environments of each market, and flag where local pathways do not support the agreed protocol.

Clinical protocols and client enablement

  • Co-develop and maintain the clinical protocols, risk frameworks and SOPs the client's on-site teams operate to, including French-language versions.
  • Design and deliver clinical training and framework guidance to client-side staff who are not clinicians, in French and English.
  • Build out the in-market provider network alongside Network Partnerships, so that in-person and overflow capacity exists as the programme scales.

Client relationship, insights and reporting

  • Act as the named clinical contact for the client's chaplaincy, medical and health and safety leads in both markets, responding within the core window to queries that are frequently unscheduled and time-critical.
  • Produce the case tracker and monthly clinical reporting, moving beyond utilisation to presenting issues, risk patterns, outcomes and service-level themes.
  • Present clinical insight at client review meetings and translate it into recommendations the client's health and safety and people teams can act on.

Requirements

  • Full professional fluency in French and English, to the standard required for clinical assessment, therapy delivery and client-facing documentation in both languages.
  • Registered clinical psychologist or qualified counsellor, with current registration in your jurisdiction and the right to practise remotely.
  • Master's degree in clinical psychology, counselling or a related field.

    Accelerating embodied AGI.

    The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century.

    MicroAGI is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data.

    We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries.

    Our models learn from data captured in the physical world, by hardware we design and build ourselves. As Embedded Engineer, you will own the firmware that runs on that hardware, from the first register write to the moment data leaves the device, so that what reaches our ML team is clean, synchronized, and trustworthy.

    What You Will Do

    • Write and own the firmware for our data-capture hardware: sensors, motion-capture rigs, custom IoT setups, and prototype robots.

    • Build real-time data acquisition: drivers, DMA, buffering, and streaming from many sensors at once without dropping a sample.

    • Solve multi-sensor synchronization, calibration, and time-stamping so every data point lines up across devices and modalities.

    • Bring up new boards with our Electrical Engineer and turn fresh hardware into working devices fast.

    • Build the path from device to dataset: communication protocols, on-device logging, and handoff into our data pipeline.

    • Work shoulder to shoulder with ML engineers. Your firmware decides what their training data looks like, and a timing bug can quietly ruin months of data.

    • Make firmware reliable in the field: testing, OTA updates, error handling, and diagnostics that tell us what went wrong.

    Requirements

    • Up to 5 years writing production firmware for embedded or IoT systems.

    • Strong C/C++, experience with an RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or similar), and deep familiarity with microcontrollers (STM32, ESP32, NXP, or similar).

    • Hands-on experience with peripheral interfaces and protocols: SPI, I2C, UART, USB, BLE, CAN, or similar.

    • Experience integrating sensors in firmware: IMUs, cameras, depth sensors, force sensors, or similar.

    • A strong understanding of how firmware decisions affect data quality, especially for EMG/EEG sensing: ADC configuration, sample rate, jitter, filtering, and buffering. You know that a great model on a noisy signal still loses to a decent model on a clean one, and you write code accordingly.

    • Comfortable debugging at the hardware boundary with a logic analyzer, oscilloscope, and debugger.

    • Genuinely curious about ML: you read papers, you have trained at least one model end to end, and you understand that dataset quality beats model architecture choice.

    • High agency: you don't wait to be told what to do. You are comfortable in 0-to-1 ambiguity, where the spec is "figure out what the spec should be".

    • Discreet: you handle confidential hardware roadmaps and customer data with care.

    • Fluent in English. German is a plus.

    Nice to Have

    • A background in robotics, motion capture, or wearable devices.

    • Experience with real-time or hard-deadline systems: audio, video sync, or robotic control loops.

    • Experience with embedded Linux, time-sync protocols (PTP or similar), or low-power design.

    • Familiarity with ML training pipelines. Even if you don't run them, you can read a training script.

    • Open-source firmware contributions.

    • Experience taking firmware from prototype to small-batch production: test fixtures, provisioning, and certification support.

    Who Will Thrive at MicroAGI

    Everyone we hire is assessed on the same four traits:

    • Mission and vision: you care about what we are building and why it matters, and your past choices show it.

    • Intensity: you work at a pace that matches the size of the opportunity, and you sustain it.

    • Entrepreneurial: you start things nobody asked for, and you finish them.

    • Raw IQ: you learn fast, reason from first principles, and get sharper when the problem changes.

    This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Analytical Chemistry Specialist – Freelance AI Trainer Project based in Switzerland.

    Are you an analytical chemistry expert interested in contributing to the next generation of artificial intelligence? This freelance opportunity allows you to apply your scientific expertise to train and evaluate advanced AI models designed to support scientific discovery, education, and laboratory research. You will assess AI-generated responses to complex analytical chemistry questions, identify inaccuracies, and strengthen scientific reasoning across a wide range of applications. Your work will help improve the accuracy, reliability, and practical relevance of AI-generated scientific knowledge. Working remotely and independently, you will contribute specialized insights to the development of more capable and trustworthy AI systems. This role is ideal for experienced chemistry professionals who enjoy solving complex problems, communicating scientific concepts, and exploring the intersection of chemistry and emerging technology.


    Accountabilities
  • Evaluate AI-generated scientific content: Review responses to theoretical and practical analytical chemistry questions, assessing their factual accuracy, logical consistency, scientific rigor, and relevance to real-world laboratory applications.
  • Apply specialized analytical chemistry knowledge: Develop and evaluate scenarios involving spectroscopy, chromatography, electrochemical analysis, quantitative chemical analysis, environmental testing, pharmaceutical analysis, and analytical method development.
  • Assess advanced analytical techniques: Challenge AI models on mass spectrometry, high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC), gas chromatography (GC), nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) interpretation, trace analysis, titrimetric methods, and related instrumentation.

Coalition Technologies is seeking a reliable, detail-oriented, and highly organized Remote Office Assistant to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, data entry, and internal operations tasks.   • Providing account access, usage reports, data analysis, and other ad hoc support for team members
  • Supporting quality assurance checks for internal and client-facing reports
  • Organizing new client contracts, creating invoices, and processing client payments

Required Skills and Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Willingness to learn, grow, and collaborate with the team and company as a whole
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • High level of discretion, ethics, and trustworthiness
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ability to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, and data entry tasks
  • Innovative thinking and willingness to challenge existing methods when improvement is possible
  • Availability to work 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Pacific Time

Preferred Skills

Growth Opportunity

Compensation

For candidates located in California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, the starting base pay for this position ranges from $15 to $25 per hour. Compensation may vary based on factors such as experience, qualifications, skills test performance, geographic location, and seniority of the position offered. For candidates outside of California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, compensation may fall outside the listed range.

  • Keep 100% of what you earn: if you charge $120/hr, you get $120/hr. A·Team makes money by charging a small, flat, transparent platform fee on top of your rate.

 

 

How to apply:

  • Missions usually involve building an ambitious piece of software from 0 to 1 as part of a small 3-4 person team. 

  • You’ll be paid to scope it out, give the client options, guide strategy, and execute on the selected solution. Sometimes the client has a clear vision, sometimes not; which is why A.Team builders tend to be senior folks who can work together to find the right direction. 

Who A·Team is for:

  • Senior software developers who left large companies and high-growth startups to pursue their craft with autonomy.

  • Those who prefer consistent contract work over a full-time role, who want to create a variety of new products alongside other top-tier builders.

  • The majority of A.Teamers spend most of their time doing independent work, but a sizeable percentage are either employed full-time (but testing out client work), bootstrapping a side project, or looking for their next big thing

Who A·Team is not for:

  • People looking for small gigs

  • Folks looking to build simple wordpress/wix/squarespace-style websites

  • Those still early in their careers (<4 years) and recent university/bootcamp grads (at least not yet)

Our long-term vision:

A·Team is a new type of company for a new kind of independent software builder. We call them "unhirables": people who traditional companies couldn’t hire full-time even if they wanted to, but who want to do their most meaningful work with their favorite people in small, autonomous, distributed expert teams.

National Director of Business Development

About Apollo After School

Apollo After School is a leading national provider of research-based extended-day programs for Pre-K–8th graders.

At Apollo After School, we create a nurturing, inclusive space where kids thrive after the bell rings. Through diverse, hands-on activities, we spark curiosity, foster lifelong learning, unleash creative potential, and nurture the self-confidence that empowers them to shine.

Our project-based curriculum turns students into confident problem-solvers. By guiding them to ask bold questions, leverage their unique strengths, and acquire fresh skills, we equip them with essential tools: goal-setting mastery, deep empathy, meaningful connections, and wise decision-making that lasts a lifetime.

Job Summary

We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven National Director of Business Development to join our growing team for a full-time position. In this role, you will drive business development by partnering with schools and districts across the United States to expand Apollo After School's extended day program. The ideal candidate is a passionate advocate for education with a proven track record in business development, particularly in the educational sector. This position is remote with significant travel required to build relationships and establish partnerships with school administrators and decision-makers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and prospect potential school and district partners nationwide through research, networking, and targeted outreach.
  • Conduct virtual and in-person presentations, demos, and meetings to showcase the value of Apollo After School programs and explore partnership opportunities.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with school principals, district administrators, and key stakeholders.
  • Develop and execute customized partnership strategies to meet or exceed quarterly and annual growth targets.
  • Collaborate with internal teams (e.g., program directors and marketing) to create tailored proposals and support onboarding of new school and district partners.
  • Track partnership activities, pipeline, and performance metrics using CRM tools like Hubspot.
  • Stay informed on educational trends, after-school program regulations, and competitive landscape to position Apollo as the top partnership choice.
  • Represent Apollo After School at industry conferences, education fairs, and regional events.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of business development experience specifically in educational programs, after-school services, or K-12 enrichment activities – experience partnering with schools or districts is highly desirable.
  • Proven ability to manage a national territory, including extensive travel (up to 50%).
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to articulate complex educational benefits to diverse audiences.
  • Valid driver's license and willingness to travel domestically.
  • Deep knowledge of after-school program funding, Title I compliance, or child development best practices.

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary ($100,000 - $125,000) plus commission structure.
  • Remote work flexibility.
  • Professional development opportunities, including business development training and attendance at education conferences.
  • The chance to make a meaningful impact on children's education and school communities.

Apollo After School is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.

To apply, please submit your resume and a cover letter outlining your relevant business development experience in education.

Salary: $100,000 – $125,000 / year

Millions of people rely on digital maps every day to navigate, to discover, to find their way. But maps are only as accurate as the data behind them, and data is only as trustworthy as the people who verify it. As an Online Data Analyst, you will use your knowledge of Spain, together with online research and project guidelines, to review and evaluate map, location, business, and search information. This is a remote, flexible independent contractor opportunity designed for people who can participate regularly each week when tasks are available.

A Day in the Life of an Online Data Analyst

﻿

In this role, you will verify, evaluate, and validate geographic and business information using advanced mapping tools and detailed reference materials.

You may work on a variety of tasks, including:

  • Review and verify map, business, address, and location information
  • Research information using online maps, search engines, directories, and reliable sources
  • Compare information from different sources and determine which result is most accurate
  • Evaluate Spanish and English language search results and information
  • Follow detailed project guidelines when making decisions
  • Work across different task types such as Maps, Search/Relevance, Audio, etc.
  • Provide accurate evaluations that help improve digital products and AI systems

Training materials, guidelines, and examples are provided.

  • Fully remote flexibility: Work from home using your own computer and a stable internet connection

  • Ongoing participation: The project is best suited to contributors interested in participating regularly when tasks are available, rather than only completing occasional tasks.
  • Variety of tasks: Depending on project needs and your qualifications, you may have opportunities to work across different task types.
  • Responsive support team: Our contributor support team can assist with project guidelines, technical questions, and administrative topics.

Qualification path

  • Professional fluency in English and Spanish (native or near-native proficiency required)
  • Have lived in Spain for the last 5 consecutive years
  • In-depth regional, cultural, and geographic knowledge of Spain
  • Willingness to work across a diverse set of Task Types (e.g. Maps, News, Audio tasks, Relevance)
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to understand and apply project guidelines
  • Willingness to participate regularly each week when work is available
  • Stable internet connection and access to a personal computer

Qualification path

  • Complete your contributor profile and submit a brief background overview
  • Verify your identity through our secure identity verification process
  • Review the open-book study guide, examples, and evaluation guidelines

  • Receive your project assignment and access credentials if successful

This is a task-based opportunity rather than an hourly-paid position.

9 EUR per hour **This hourly equivalent is provided as an estimate only.

Actual earnings may vary depending on:

  • The type of tasks completed
  • The volume of available tasks
  • The number of tasks you choose to complete
  • Quality and productivity requirements
  • Your individual pace of work
  • Your level of regular participation

Independent Contractor Relationship

This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis.

Contributors have flexibility in deciding when they participate and how much available work they choose to complete, subject to project availability, qualification requirements, and project quality standards.

Position Purpose:
The Lead VBC Quality Consultant serves as the strategic quality advisor for an assigned portfolio of Value-Based Care organizations. The role analyzes performance, identifies opportunities, develops quality improvement strategies, and partners with provider organizations to improve Medicare Stars, HEDIS, CAHPS, and other quality outcomes. The consultant serves as the primary quality liaison between internal teams and external provider partners and is accountable for coordinating execution, monitoring results, and escalating barriers.

Key Details: Value-Based Care experience and Medicare Quality experience highly preferred.

  • Manage a portfolio of approximately 8–10 VBC organizations and serve as the primary national quality contact for assigned accounts.

  • Establish annual, quarterly, and monthly quality priorities based on contract goals, performance trends, population needs, and identified performance risk.

  • Develop partner-specific quality strategies, action plans, milestones, and accountability mechanisms; monitor execution and intervene when progress is off track.

  • Track performance against Medicare Stars, HEDIS, CAHPS, medication adherence, clinical quality, member experience, and applicable VBC quality goals.

  • Analyze provider-, measure-, and member-level data to identify performance drivers, care-gap opportunities, emerging risks, and variation across markets or provider groups.

  • Translate complex findings into focused initiatives that improve gap closure, medication adherence, preventive care, chronic condition management, and member experience.

  • Assess intervention effectiveness, recommend course corrections, and share scalable best practices across the VBC portfolio.

  • Partner with Market Quality, Network, Provider Engagement, Analytics, Pharmacy, Risk Adjustment, Clinical Operations, Data/EMR teams, and leadership to align strategy and execution.

  • Lead or contribute to cross-functional workgroups that address performance barriers, data issues, provider workflow needs, and enterprise quality priorities.

  • Bring provider insights and recurring barriers back to internal teams to inform national strategy, resource allocation, and process improvement.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

  • Complies with all policies and standards.

Bachelor's Degree Nursing, Public Health, Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, or related field, or equivalent relevant experience. required


Master's Degree preferred
: 5+ years experience in Medicare quality improvement, Medicare Stars, HEDIS, population health, or closely related work. required

This is a senior delivery role. You are accountable for the budget, scope, timeline, and the customer relationship on every project you run, and you carry the conversations that come with them. We want someone who has already managed complex enterprise implementations, understands the challenges of ERP integration, and who has worked in a delivery model where AI does a meaningful share of the work. In this model, you understand that the project manager’s job is to make sure the work is defined well enough for AI and human steps to flow smoothly and with minimal intervention.

What you will do

  • Own the project from signature to post-launch and deliver it on time, in scope, and on budget.

  • Turn the contract into a work breakdown with estimates that roll up to the sold number, and close discovery with the Solution Architect on that basis.

  • Keep the backlog ready. Every piece of work has a trace to the agreed solution design, acceptance criteria, an estimate and its dependencies before it goes to the team.

  • Keep the project record complete, with every project meeting recorded and filed so the design, the plan and the team’s AI tools can work from it.

  • Run the project week to week. Record and communicate budget burn, risks and mitigations, blockers with an owner and a date, dependencies on the customer’s IT and ERP partners, and a status the sponsor can act on without a call.

  • Carry the hard conversations. When scope or expectations drift, say what it costs, defend the team’s estimate and the agreed scope, and route the rest through change control.

  • Keep the customer relationship and the team healthy through the hard parts. The sponsor and customer trust your numbers, and the team trusts you to protect their estimates and their time.

  • Take the first call on customer escalations and bring rebaselines and change orders to the customer on your own.

  • Mentor Project Managers and build the templates, dashboards and working practices the PMO runs on.

What we are looking for

Experience and qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Seven or more years managing software implementation projects with a contracted budget for enterprise customers, with commerce, PIM or ERP integration projects in the Microsoft ecosystem strongly preferred.

  • Experience delivering in an AI-accelerated methodology, where meeting records, solution design and backlog quality are what the AI tools and the engineers build from, and where you have seen what happens when they are not in order.

  • A track record of turning a Statement of Work and its change orders into a work breakdown that rolls up to the contract, and of holding that number through delivery.

  • Working knowledge of Dynamics 365 from the project side, enough to understand what the integration work is and why it takes the time it does.

  • Fluent with the work management, time tracking and financial tools a delivery team runs on, and used to keeping them reconciled.

Skills

  • Writes work definitions and acceptance criteria that a developer can build from without a conversation.

  • Delivers a firm message to an enterprise customer with the data behind it and stays in the room when it gets hard.

  • Builds trust with the customer and their team early, and keeps it through a firm conversation or a change order.

  • Reads budget burn and acts on a deviation before it becomes an overrun.

  • Holds several accounts at once without losing accuracy on any of them.

  • Writes updates a director or a customer sponsor can act on without a call.

  • Uses AI tools daily in their own work and checks what they produce before it reaches anyone else.

Who you are

You like owning a number and a customer relationship at the same time, and you’re comfortable being the person who says what a change will cost. You would rather define the work properly once. You have already worked with AI in delivery, you have an opinion on where it helps, and you want to be on a team that is putting it to work. You take ownership, build trust, drive innovation and succeed together, and you expect the same of the people around you.

Other information

  • Employment type: Full-time (40 hours/week)

  • Start date: Upon agreement

  • Location: Remote (U.S.), occasional travel for kickoffs and go-lives

  • Reports to: Director of Project Delivery, Commerce North America

  • Compensation: USD 80,000–100,000 annually, depending on experience and qualifications.

About Truvio

Truvio is a fast-growing SaaS company that combines established Microsoft Dynamics ISVs into one product portfolio built for Dynamics 365, helping customers get more value from their ERP investments. With our core values Take ownership, Build Trust, Drive innovation and Succeed together, we are about 450 employees worldwide across North America, Europe, Asia and Australia.

Job Description

The Role


The HR Solutions Enablement team builds effective, scalable, and cohesive HR solutions that minimize redundancy and deliver seamless data and insights for a better end-user experience.


You’ll join a team that implements Workday and integrated third-party HR technology solutions to streamline operations and reduce friction. The team also provides Tier 2 support to business users. As the Sr. HR Technology Analyst for Hourly Compensation, you’ll design, configure, and maintain complex compensation processes across multiple countries and facilities, each with distinct requirements. This role combines consultative problem-solving, end-to-end execution, and the ability to influence without formal authority to deliver high-impact HR solutions.

Success in this role requires strong collaboration, consultation, and influence skills. You’ll partner with teams across the business to understand their challenges and implement optimal technology solutions—for example, translating hourly wage structures, step-progression rules, premiums, and allowances into robust, scalable Workday solutions that are accurate, compliant, and auditable.


The ideal candidate brings extensive hands-on experience with Workday Compensation configuration, working knowledge of adjacent Workday modules, and a passion for continuous improvement and solution design. You’ll serve as a Workday subject-matter expert and solution designer who improves system effectiveness, user experience, and operational scalability. Familiarity with emerging AI-powered tools and agents is valued, particularly where they can improve the end-user experience, Workday configurations and business processes.


Flexibility is important, as this role may occasionally require work outside standard hours to support global stakeholders and critical projects.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and configure end-to-end Workday solutions for global hourly compensation, including compensation packages, grades, grade profiles, steps, eligibility rules, and plan assignments.
  • Configure and maintain complex hourly compensation components, including:
    • Base wage structures and wage scales
    • Premium pay structures and differential rules
    • Automatic step-progression schedules based on anniversaries, hours worked, or other business rules
    • Local allowances such as COLA, hazard, seniority, tool, transportation, and housing allowances
    • 13th- and 14th-month pay or similar country-specific components, where applicable
  • Translate requirements from local collective bargaining agreements (CBAs), country legislation, and compensation policies into clear, sustainable, and testable Workday solutions.
  • Design and maintain compensation eligibility rules using job profile, location, union or collective agreement, employee type, and other relevant attributes.
  • Lead or support projects to standardize and expand hourly compensation configuration, including discovery, design workshops, configuration, testing, deployment, and hypercare.
  • Partner with Payroll and Integration teams to ensure Workday compensation configurations support accurate downstream pay calculations and payroll processing.
  • Collaborate with Reporting and Analytics teams to ensure hourly compensation data supports downstream reporting, compliance, benchmarking, and decision-making.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues related to hourly compensation, including eligibility errors, incorrect rates, step-progression defects, and missing allowances.
  • Execute and coordinate unit, integration, regression, and end-user testing; develop thorough test scenarios and maintain documentation describing solution configuration and expected outcomes.
  • Evaluate Workday releases and assess impacts to Compensation configuration, integrations, reporting, security, and business processes.
  • Apply Workday security and access controls, support data audits and control activities, and ensure configuration changes are documented, traceable and approved through established governance processes.
  • Validate, reconcile, and execute EIBs and other mass data updates in accordance with established data-quality and change-control standards.

Core Capabilities

  • Configuration and solution design: Independently turns complex hourly compensation problems into scalable Workday designs that balance standardization, usability, compliance and maintainability.
  • Stakeholder and consulting skills: Builds trust with HR, Compensation, Payroll, Labor Relations, and Technology stakeholders; clarifies requirements; and influences decisions with clear options and recommendations.
  • Execution discipline: Plans and delivers configuration work from design through testing, deployment, and hypercare with strong ownership and follow-through.
  • Continuous improvement and analysis: Uses data and root-cause analysis to diagnose issues and identify opportunities for process improvement, automation and better user experience.
  • Quality, governance, and controls: Maintains high standards for documentation, testing, change control, auditability, security and sustainable solution design.

Required Qualifications

  • You have 7+ years of progressive experience in HR technology, HRIS, compensation, or a related field, including at least 4 years of hands-on Workday configuration experience with a focus on Compensation.
  • You have advanced knowledge of hourly compensation practices, including wage scales, step progression, premiums, allowances, and related eligibility rules, and can model them cleanly in Workday.
  • You are fluent in Workday Compensation building blocks, including compensation packages, grades, grade profiles, steps, eligibility rules, and plan assignments, and understand how they work together.
  • You have built or supported Workday custom reports and calculated fields tied to compensation.
  • You are comfortable using Workday EIBs and mass-update patterns to safely move data at scale, including validation, reconciliation, and post-load review.
  • You can translate dense policy, legislation, and CBA language into clear, testable configurations and explain the logic to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • You have experience working across multiple countries or regions and navigating different regulatory and contractual environments to implement complex hourly compensation solutions.
  • You demonstrate professionalism, discretion and sound judgment when accessing sensitive employee information, using it only for legitimate business purposes and authorized work activities.
  • You bring strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with high attention to detail, data quality, and root-cause analysis.
  • You manage your work independently in a structured, change-managed environment and consistently deliver on your commitments.
  • You communicate clearly, in writing and in meetings, with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What Will Give You An Edge

  • You hold a Workday Pro certification in Compensation or comparable advanced Workday training.
  • You have supported large hourly or manufacturing populations and understand the realities of plant and operations environments.
  • You have translated union or collective bargaining agreements into Workday designs for pay, step progression, premiums and allowances.
  • You have worked across additional Workday domains, such as Core HCM, Absence, Benefits, Recruiting, Talent, or Advanced Compensation, to design end-to-end HR solutions.
  • You understand Workday security fundamentals, including domain and business process security, role-based access, audit requirements, and internal controls.
  • You have led or co-led multi-country Workday initiatives or compensation optimizations and are comfortable owning portions of a global roadmap.
  • You have demonstrated the ability to identify and responsibly apply AI-powered tools or agents, such as copilots, chatbots, or automation frameworks, to improve the end-user experience, Workday configurations and business processes.

The SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) Functional Lead Analyst provides functional leadership for the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of SAP MDG processes and solutions. This role leads business requirements, functional design, governance alignment, testing, and stakeholder decision-making across master data domains. The MDG Functional Lead translates business needs into scalable SAP MDG solutions while guiding the technical teams responsible for configuration, integrations, and development. This is a functional leadership role, not a primary ABAP development position. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Serve as the SAP MDG functional lead and subject matter expert for assigned master data domains. Lead discovery, requirements, process design, and functional solution workshops with business and IT stakeholders. Translate business and governance requirements into functional specifications, process designs, and acceptance criteria. Own functional solution decisions and recommend scalable, supportable SAP MDG approaches that balance business value, user experience, and complexity.

Define functional requirements for MDG data models, workflows, business rules, validations, search, duplicate checks, and replication. Provide functional guidance to technical teams responsible for configuration, integrations, interfaces, and custom development; review delivered solutions for alignment with approved designs.

Lead functional delivery for Material, Business Partner (Customer and Supplier), and/or Finance master data domains. Apply deep knowledge of domain processes, data dependencies, controls, and governance requirements to solution decisions.

Partner with Data Owners, Data Stewards, and process leaders to define priorities and improve master data processes. Translate data governance policies into functional controls, validations, approvals, and data quality requirements. Lead cross-functional analysis and resolution of recurring process and data quality issues.

Own the functional test strategy, scenarios, expected results, defect triage, and business acceptance for unit, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing. Validate end-to-end MDG processes and confirm solutions meet approved business and governance requirements. Provide functional leadership for data migration readiness, validation, and business sign-off during phased SAP rollouts. Maintain functional design, decision, process, and testing documentation.

Lead continuous improvement of workflows, user experience, governance controls, and process efficiency. Represent the functional workstream in upgrades, enhancements, rollout planning, and SAP MDG roadmap initiatives.

Mentor MDG functional analysts and support resources; promote consistent functional methods and documentation standards. Ensure functional designs align with enterprise architecture, data governance, security, and support standards.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

This job has no supervisory responsibilities.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

Bachelor's degree from an accredited college/university. 7+ years of SAP functional experience, including hands-on SAP MDG functional design, process configuration, governance, and testing. 3+ years leading SAP MDG functional workstreams, solution design, stakeholder decisions, and cross-functional delivery. Demonstrated ability to direct technical delivery and review configuration, integrations, and development without serving as the primary developer.

COMPETENCIES

Evaluates Problems: Evaluates and analyzes different types of information objectively to identify appropriate solutions; writes fluently, establishing the key facts clearly and interprets numerical data effectively. Technical Communication/ Presentation: Communicates with clarity and precision, presenting complex information in a concise format that is appropriate for the audience. Adjusting and Driving Change: Takes a positive approach to tackling work and embraces change; invites feedback relating to performance and deals constructively with criticism. Identifies the need for and drives change when required to achieve objectives. Focuses on Customers: Understands and anticipates customer needs and takes action to provide high-quality products and services to exceed expectations. Demonstrates Business Acumen: Demonstrates working knowledge of the market, economic, legal, and regulatory environments and how they impact the business. Agile Best Practices: Understands how agility is leveraged in IT ways of working. Adopts agile best practices as appropriate throughout the assigned work lifecycle. Responds to feedback quickly based on comments from internal and external customers and needs of the market. Bias for Action: Takes initiative and identifies what needs to be done and acts without waiting to be asked. Executes work in a timely manner. Suggests improvements to current ways of working.

BFS COMPETENCIES

Business and Financial Acumen

Demonstrates depth of understanding for the P&L and financial analysis Teaches business and financial acumen to others. Understands KPIs and how BFS makes money. Knows the different business segments and how they relate to one another. Understands customer sales and engagement. Demonstrates functional and/or technical expertise. Understands complex issues and demonstrates problem solving skills. Understands how to maximize business results regardless of industry cycle.

Results Driven

Holds self and others accountable. Communicates and sets clear goals with plans to deliver. Manages competing priorities effectively. Demonstrates appropriate urgency. Drives to exceed expectations in alignment with our BFS SPICE values. Embraces and follows best practices. Demonstrates self-starter, can-do attitude.

Strategic Thinking and Decision Making

Leverages resources and teams around them to solve problems and create mutually beneficial outcomes. Demonstrates willingness and courage to make tough decisions in a timely manner. Balances short-and-long term priorities Demonstrates proactive versus reactive thinking. Asks questions to identify root cause and analyze situations more accurately.

Servant Leadership

Demonstrates humility by putting others first. Builds trust-based relationships. Leads by example with kindness and respect. Collaborates well across all areas of the business. Advocates for others Actively listens to understand the meaning and intent of what the other person is communicating. Demonstrates authenticity and encourages others to do the same.

Emotional Intelligence

Demonstrates situational awareness – knows when and how to adjust leadership style in different situations. Demonstrates self-awareness – understands strengths and weaknesses. Demonstrates empathy – puts themselves in other’s shoes. Assumes positive intent.

Develops and Leads Others

Drives alignment through clear communication of vision, goals, and expectations. Invests time on a regular basis in performance feedback and developmental conversations. Fosters a respectful and inclusive environment. Empowers, motivates, and inspires others. Coaches and mentor others for their development. Guides and persuades others to deliver positive outcomes.

Growth Mindset

Demonstrates a growth mindset; takes appropriate risks, fails fast and forward, learns from mistakes. Perseverance and champions growth, even in the face of resistance, ambiguity, or possible failure. Thinks like an owner with an entrepreneurial spirit. Demonstrates and encourages intellectual curiosity. Continuous learner; seeks opportunities and knowledge for personal and professional growth. Sees possibilities over problems – actively seeks solutions.

Innovation

Encourages out-of-the box thinking to create new ways of doing things. Continuously seeks to improve and simplify pain points in the business. Anticipates, embraces, and leads change. Develops and executes breakthrough strategies.

Integrity

Does the right thing even under challenging circumstances? Communicates with honesty. Consistently treats others fairly and equitably. Demonstrates reliability and does what they say they will do. Conducts tough conversations and delivers difficult messages with kindness and respect.

WORK ENVIRONMENT / PHYSICAL ACTIVITY

MULTI GDS TRAINER SPECIALIST

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

Ranked as one of the world’s top five travel management companies, it has a business network in over 97 countries and global headquarters in London, Brisbane, Singapore and New York. Backed by the global strength of Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combines local expertise and global experience to provide clients with a truly bespoke experience.

Established in June 2004, FCM has been named World’s Best Travel Management Company for eight years running at the World Travel Awards.

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

About The Opportunity

Join a team passionate about travel, learning, and operational excellence. As a Multi GDS Trainer Specialist, you'll play a critical role in developing and delivering training that empowers agents to maximize their expertise across key global distribution systems, with a strong focus on Sabre. This role combines training delivery, program development, process documentation, and business support to enhance productivity and service quality across the organization. If you enjoy coaching others, creating learning resources, and driving continuous improvement, this is an exciting opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver Sabre training programs for both novice and experienced users.
  • Facilitate ongoing training and upskilling initiatives for existing agents.
  • Develop, maintain, and enhance multi-course training programs and materials.
  • Create and document training processes, procedures, and learning resources.
  • Review and update training content to reflect new processes and system enhancements.
  • Monitor new Sabre releases and communicate updates, shortcuts, and efficiencies to end users.
  • Support adoption and training for Red Apps and related technologies.
  • Identify and implement efficiency opportunities through Red Apps utilization.
  • Provide RAP customer support.
  • Maintain the training library and ensure resources remain current and accessible.
  • Support the Customer Care Team with training-related assistance.
  • Create documentation and training materials for scripts and automation processes.
  • Monitor and respond to inquiries received through the training mailbox.
  • Deliver monthly "coffee break" learning sessions for agents.
  • Provide one-on-one coaching and support as needed.
  • Work independently to develop documentation, processes, and training initiatives.
  • Occasional travel may be required.
  • Other duties and tasks as assigned
  • Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive

Experience & Qualifications

  • Extensive knowledge of Sabre required.
  • Extensive knowledge of Amadeus required.
  • Knowledge of operational processes preferred.
  • Understanding of consultant workflow from PNR through reporting preferred.
  • Experience creating training materials, documentation, or learning programs.
  • Training or facilitation background preferred.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
  • Structured, highly organized, and detail-oriented approach.
  • Experience supporting process improvements and systems adoption is an advantage.
  • Reliable, high-speed internet connectivity required to support core job responsibilities, including but not limited to video conferencing, access to company systems, and secure handling of company data.

Work Perks! - What’s in it for you:

FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.

  • Have fun:At the heart of everything we do at Flight Centre is a desire to have fun.
  • Reward & Recognition: Celebrate the success of yourself and others at our regular Buzz Nights and at the annual Global Gathering - You'll have to experience it to believe it!
  • Use your smarts:Our people use their quick thinking, expertise, and tenacity to always figure things out.
  • Love for travel:We were founded by people who wanted to travel and want others to do the same. That passion is something you can’t miss in our people or service.
  • Personal connections:We are a big business founded on personal relationships.
  • Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through initiatives like Diversity Day (paid leave to observe a holiday or cultural celebration of your choice) Employee Resource Groups (Racial Equity, Gender Equity, LGBTQ2IA+, Accessibility, Environmental Justice), DEI education initiatives, and equitable practices, including regular equity assessments and inclusive recruitment protocols.
  • A career, not a job:We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve
  • We back our people all the way: We are strongly committed to supporting every single employee in their professional and personal development.
  • Giving Back:Our Corporate Social Responsibility program supports nominated charities through volunteering and fundraising, complemented by our Office Environmental Program, LEED® Gold-certified office spaces, and 1 paid Volunteer Day per calendar year.

Benefits Include:

  • Paid Time Off: A comprehensive time off package, including up to 15 vacation days (prorated upon hire and increasing to 20 days after 2 years of employment), 5 sick days, 3 personal days, 1 Diversity Day, 1 Volunteer Day, and 9 recognized holidays annually.
  • Travel perks/discounts
  • Health & Wellness Programs and Employee Financial Wellness Services
  • National/International Award Nights and Conferences
  • Health benefits including, medical, dental, vision, gender affirming care, and fertility care
  • Insurance including hospital indemnity, AD&D, critical illness, long-term and short-term disability
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • 401k program with partial match
  • Tuition Reimbursement Program
  • Employee Share Plan – Ability to purchase company stock on Australian Stock Exchange with partial company match, subject to terms and conditions
  • Global career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses

*Vacation, Personal, and Sick time accrual rates will vary based on full-time or part-time employee status. Recognized Holidays are either paid time off or, if required to work due to job requirements, holiday pay rate, and may vary depending on state.

Location – Remote, USA

If this sounds like the opportunity you have been waiting for then APPLY NOW.

For this position, we anticipate offering an annual salary of $70,000 - $75,000. Base salary is dependent on relevant factors, including experience, geographic location, and job requirements.

As part of our recruitment process, we may use AI tools to assist in various stages, including the screening and assessment of applications. These tools support our evaluation of candidates based on role relevant qualifications, skills and experience. All decisions are made by our hiring team and stakeholders.

We thank all candidates for their interest; however, only those selected to continue in the process will be contacted.

Our number one philosophy? Our people. Flight Center Travel Group USA’s promise is to provide an environment with equality of respect, dignity and opportunity for all our employees. We value an inclusive and supportive workplace which truly reflects the diversity of our society.

We are an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer committed to providing a barrier-free pathway throughout our recruitment process. Full-time, permanent

Salary up to £35,000

Turn ideas, client needs and AI opportunities into products that are clear, buildable and ready to deliver.

ICS.AI is the UK’s market leader in AI solutions for local government, partnering with more than 20 councils to transform public service delivery. Our products span AI contact centres, staff copilots and social care copilots, helping organisations improve resident experiences, increase productivity and deliver smarter services.

We’re looking for a Product Specialist to take ownership of one of our core products. Sitting within the Product team and reporting to the Product Manager, you’ll become the product authority turning client and business needs into validated specifications, a sprint-ready backlog and accurate product documentation.

What you’ll be doing

  • Leading the Specify process for core product builds, creating detailed specifications and AI-assisted prototypes.
  • Managing and maintaining the backlog for one core product in Azure DevOps.
  • Grooming, prioritising and sizing backlog items with the Product Manager so the backlog stays sprint-ready.
  • Writing clear user stories and acceptance criteria that support confident development, testing and release.
  • Producing and maintaining user guides, release notes, onboarding materials and process documentation.
  • Turning feedback from client user groups, AI Champion networks, QBRs and service tickets into structured backlog inputs.
  • Contributing to sprint reviews, retrospectives and backlog refinement sessions across product lines.
  • Supporting go-to-market materials, feature descriptions and release communications.

What makes this role different

This is a hands-on product ownership role at the centre of how ICS.AI specifies and builds AI products. You’ll work closely with Delivery, Technical Leads, Engineering and the Product Manager, using AI-assisted prototyping to move from an identified need to a clear, testable and buildable solution. Your impact will be visible in the quality of the backlog, the clarity of the product documentation and the confidence with which features move into delivery.

What we’re looking for

  • Hands-on experience managing an Agile backlog and taking part in sprint ceremonies, typically gained as a Product Owner, Business Analyst or in a similar technology, AI or software role.
  • Strong written communication, with the ability to translate complex requirements into clear user stories, acceptance criteria and specifications.
  • Confidence using AI prototyping and requirements tools, including vibe-prototyping platforms.
  • A structured, detail-focused approach to documentation and backlog management.
  • The ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Knowledge of GenAI, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation and agentic AI—including a practical understanding of what AI agents can and cannot do.
  • A practical understanding of SaaS or AI product development, release management and versioning.
  • Eligibility to work in the UK. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Nice to have

  • Experience as a Product Owner.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps Boards or equivalent backlog tooling.
  • Hands-on use of AI or vibe-prototyping tools to create working prototypes or specifications.
  • Experience of local government or wider public sector service delivery.
  • A Product Owner certification such as CSPO or PSPO.

The package

  • Salary up to £35,000.
  • Full-time, permanent role.
  • Remote within the UK, with occasional travel to Basingstoke and client sites.
  • £100 per month working-from-home allowance.
  • Vitality Healthcare Plan.
  • Pension scheme.
  • 25 days’ holiday.
  • Support for relevant professional development and qualifications.

Ready to help shape AI products that improve public services?

Apply to join ICS.AI and help turn real client needs into clearly specified, well-documented AI products that teams can build and customers can use with confidence.

Salary: up to £35K

Job Title

Lead Integrations Architect

Job Description Summary

Job Description

Lead Integrations Architect
TDS Technology & Data Solutions | Reports to Global Head of Data Architecture & Engineering | Hybrid/Remote, US/EMEA hours

The role
You will own integration architecture across C&W's data and application estate as the firm's go-to authority. You will set the standards, design and build the hardest integrations yourself, and raise the capability of delivery teams around you.

What you'll do

  • Define and govern our integration patterns (API, point-to-point, hub-and-spoke, ESB, iPaaS, event-driven, bi-directional sync) and guide teams on when to use each.
  • Design end-to-end integrations across custom, SaaS and PaaS systems, covering data contracts, error handling, observability, security and scale.
  • Build the most complex, highest-risk integrations hands-on and prove them production-ready.
  • Create reference architectures and reusable components so teams build faster and more consistently.
  • Lead architecture on strategic programmes, owning design, sequencing and trade-offs.
  • Coach engineers through design and code reviews.
  • Steer the move from legacy point-to-point and ESB estates to modern patterns, with clear cutover and rollback plans.
  • Surface security, reliability and data integrity risks and drive them to resolution through governance forums.
  • Advise engineering, data, AI, product and business stakeholders, and work closely with Data Engineering, Security, Infrastructure and Architecture.

What you'll bring

  • Senior experience designing and building data integrations at scale across custom, SaaS and PaaS.
  • Hands-on depth across multiple integration patterns, plus .NET and C#.
  • Working knowledge of iPaaS, event-driven architecture and bi-directional sync.
  • A track record of leading through influence and setting technical standards in a complex enterprise.
  • Strong grasp of integration security, identity, observability and data governance in regulated, global settings.

Nice to have

  • Experience retiring legacy ESB or point-to-point estates.
  • Familiarity with API management, message brokers and streaming platforms.
  • Experience in a global data organisation across time zones.

      <title>Salesloft: Principal Software Engineer, AI</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States, Remote
</p>

<p><span><strong>Job Title:</strong> Principal Software Engineer, AI&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span><strong>Location</strong>: Remote - US</span></p>
<p>Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.</p>
<p>With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.</p>
<p>Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.</p>
<p><strong>THE OPPORTUNITY</strong></p>
<p>At Salesloft, our Principal Engineer for AI sets the technical direction for how machine intelligence works across our Predictive Revenue System. This is the most senior individual-contributor role on our AI engineering team: you will architect the systems that turn LLMs, machine learning models, and agentic workflows into production capabilities that thousands of enterprise revenue teams depend on.</p>
<p>This is deep, ambiguous, frontier work. You will make the foundational architectural decisions for AI at Salesloft — how we serve models at scale, how we build reliable systems on top of non-deterministic components, how we evaluate and guardrail agentic behavior, and how we keep pace as the underlying foundation models evolve. You will set the standards other engineers build on and act as a technical multiplier across the AI organization.</p>
<p>On a day-to-day basis, you will:</p>
<ul>
<li>Set the technical architecture and direction for AI systems across the platform — model serving, LLM-powered features, agentic workflows, and the infrastructure beneath them.</li>
<li>Design production-grade systems that are reliable and observable despite being built on non-deterministic, probabilistic AI components.</li>
<li>Architect evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and quality systems that make AI behavior safe, measurable, and trustworthy at enterprise scale.</li>
<li>Lead the most complex AI engineering problems end to end — from research-adjacent prototyping through hardened production delivery.</li>
<li>Establish engineering standards and best practices for building AI-native systems, and mentor senior engineers across the org.</li>
<li>Keep the platform at the frontier by evaluating and integrating advances in foundation models, agent frameworks, and the modern AI stack.</li>
</ul>
<p>This role lives at the heart of how we Lead From the Front: you'll work at the edge of applied AI, prototype rapidly, and make architectural bets ahead of the field. And in the spirit of how we Make Your Mark, you'll set the AI engineering standards and systems that the entire organization builds on — engineered for scale, not for a demo.</p>
<p><strong>WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR</strong></p>
<p>We are looking for an engineer who operates at the highest level of technical authority in AI systems — someone who has architected and shipped production AI at scale and understands the deep challenges of building reliable systems on probabilistic foundations. You lead through technical credibility and make the engineers around you better.</p>
<p>You embody what we call Evidence Over Ego — you make architectural decisions from evaluation data and evidence rather than hype, you invite rigorous challenge, and you change direction when the models or the data move. You bring systems thinking to a genuinely unsolved problem space and build for durability.</p>
<p>This is the right role if you want to define how AI works on a platform at the center of enterprise revenue.</p>
<p><strong>THE TEAM</strong></p>
<p>The Salesloft AI Engineering organization builds the machine intelligence at the core of the Predictive Revenue System. The team works at the intersection of applied research and production engineering, in close partnership with Product, Data Science, and Data Platform Engineering.</p>
<p>The team Moves as One — AI engineering, product, and data science share ownership of shipping trustworthy AI and make hard technical calls together. And we are relentlessly Customer Inspired: every AI capability is measured against whether it makes revenue teams genuinely more successful and more confident in the system.</p>
<p><strong>THE SKILL SET</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Extensive experience building and architecting production software systems at scale, with significant depth in AI/ML systems.</li>
<li>Hands-on experience building production systems on top of LLMs or machine learning models — including designing for the challenges of non-deterministic behavior.</li>
<li>Deep expertise in distributed systems, model serving, and the infrastructure required to run AI reliably at scale.</li>
<li>Proven experience designing evaluation frameworks, guardrails, or quality systems for AI-driven features.</li>
<li>A track record of setting technical architecture and standards across teams and mentoring senior engineers.</li>
<li>Strong command of a major programming language (e.g., Python, Java, or Go) and modern cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP).</li>
<li>Hands-on experience with agentic systems — designing and hardening AI agents that take autonomous action in production.</li>
<li>Depth in the modern AI stack — retrieval-augmented generation, vector stores, agent frameworks, model orchestration, or evaluation tooling.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>BENEFITS:</strong></p>
<p>For more information about our company's comprehensive benefits please visit: https://salesloftbenefits.com/</p>
<p>At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.</p>
<p>We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.</p>
<p>If you’re excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team. Explore our open roles and consider joining us!</p>
<p>Please note that all official communication regarding job opportunities at Clari + Salesloft will come from&nbsp;@ <a href="http://salesloft.com">salesloft.com</a> email address. If you receive messages on LinkedIn or other job platforms claiming to be from Salesloft, they may not be legitimate. To verify the authenticity of any job-related communication, please visit our official <a href="https://salesloft.com/company/careers/">Careers Page</a>.</p>
<p><em>We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, notetaking, or summarizing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment - all hiring decisions are made by people. If you would like more information about how your data is processed or prefer to opt out of any AI-assisted tools, please let your recruiter know. Opting out will not impact your experience or consideration.</em></p>

<li>Passion for clean code, scalable architecture, and incrementally reducing complexity over time.</li>
<li>Ability to manage time, prioritize effectively, and thrive in a fast-moving environment.</li>
<li>Clear communication skills with both technical and non-technical collaborators.</li>
<li>Willingness to flexibly support other domains (e.g., Product, Marketing, and Engineering) as the team grows.</li>

<ul>

<li>A track record of transforming manual, ad hoc workflows into scalable data pipelines.</li>
<li>Familiarity with billing systems, GAAP accounting, revenue recognition, or audit support.</li>
<li>Exposure to Stripe, Salesforce, or Orb in billing and finance contexts.</li>

      <title>Lithic: Senior Software Engineer, Card Authorization</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote 
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Lithic is the modern card issuing and processing platform empowering ambitious financial companies to build the future of payments.</p>
<p>Our infrastructure powers card programs for 100+ innovative clients, from fintechs reimagining credit and digital banking to platforms transforming disbursements and spend management. Companies like Mercury, Flex, and Novo rely on Lithic's developer-friendly APIs, direct network connections, and flawless reconciliation to launch and scale card programs in weeks, not years.</p>
<p>We're building a future where access to better financial products materially improves people's lives, free from the constraints of 30-year-old mainframes and legacy processors. We're proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Stripes, and Mastercard, along with many others.&nbsp;</p>
<p>We're a team of 170+ across 26 states and 7 countries, headquartered in New York City.&nbsp;</p></div><p>We are hiring a <strong>Senior Software Engineer</strong> for Lithic’s Card Authorization team, which owns the real-time systems that make every card authorization decision correct, reliable, and fast. The team also owns related fraud tooling, including Lithic’s Rules Engine and 3D Secure integration. You’ll own high-impact projects end-to-end, solve distributed-systems problems at scale, and help build the tools customers use to control fraud and payment risk.</p>
<h3><strong>What you'll do:</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Write reliable, secure, scalable code for Lithic’s real-time authorization and fraud-prevention systems with minimal tech debt</li>
<li>Build customer-facing features, such as rules improvements, velocity controls, 3DS flows, fraud tooling, and transaction monitoring. Own projects from planning to launch.</li>
<li>Improve the reliability of systems in team’s scope and participate in the team on-call rotation</li>
<li>Lead efforts to improve systems and processes within the team</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>What you'll bring:</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>4+ years building production backend systems. Full stack experience is a plus.</li>
<li>Experience in or desire to learn Rust; ability to understand Lithic’s system written in other programming languages (Python, Java)</li>
<li>Interest and experience in leveraging AI tools to enhance productivity</li>
<li>Ability to navigate ambiguity, align diverse perspectives, and drive toward practical solutions</li>
<li>Experience or interest in payments, fintech, fraud prevention.</li>
<li>Comfort with designing systems from scratch and owning the product development process end-to-end</li>
<li>Strong written communication skills and experience working in a remote, async-first team that’s spread across time zones</li>
</ul>
<p>The annual US salary range for this role is $160,000 to $200,000 plus equity. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Lithic and will be narrowed during the interview process based on the candidate’s experience and qualifications.&nbsp;</p>
<p>This is a remote position. However, candidates must be located in the United States, Canada (Ontario or British Columbia), Netherlands, Poland, or Czech Republic. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance.</p>
